additional_info.subject: Additional description:
additional_info.body:
Hello,
A client tried to charge with POS today 3 of February between 5:12 and 5:20 PM CU TIME but there was no energy delivery. The screen showed "payment accepted. Impossible to start the recharge". He then charged correctly at 5:31 PM CU TIME with our App. The authorizations were all accepted.
Can you please check the logs to help us better understand what happened?
Thank you
software version : v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476235-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002445] Check on logs CRM:02681001391
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for reporting this incident.
After checking the logs we can see that the session stopped in control pilot state E, which means in error.
The error message was
"message response sending failed V2G09MSGSequence_V2GDINSession_V2GDINContractAuthentication_V2GIDNCAUProcessRequest_V2GDINCAUProcessRequest_OK\"
I have saved the logs and the expert team will analyze it as soon as possible.
We will let you know when we have an update.
Thank you!
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,

additional_info.subject: ID0476235-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002445] Check on logs CRM:02681001391
additional_info.body:
Dear
Rosita
,
Following your report and after our checks, we can see that the charge session failed. The root cause of this issue was on the EV side, as the vehicle was not ready for power delivery.
As shown in the attached screenshot, the EV target was set to
0
, which indicates that the vehicle was not requesting any power at the time.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team

Younes Baroudi
